info.name: LibraLink API Tests
info.description:
Complete API test collection for LibraLink Backend - All 79 endpoints with test scripts.

SETUP:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set the 'baseUrl' variable to your backend URL (default: http://localhost:8080)
3. Run the 'Auth > Register' or 'Auth > Login' request first to get a JWT token
4. The token is auto-saved to the collection variable 'authToken'
5. All authenticated requests use this token automatically
